description: This file is a C source file implementing a JSON plugin module for a device management system. It includes functions for handling JSON data, interacting with UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) and UBUS (a message bus), and managing JSON-based configuration and communication, including object parsing, validation, and data retrieval/set operations.

methods.name: void save_json_data(struct list_head * json_list,char * name,json_object * data,int json_version,const char ** in_p,const char ** out_p,const char ** ev_arg)
methods.description: Allocates and adds a JSON data node to a list, setting its data and attributes.

methods.name: void free_json_data(struct list_head * json_list)
methods.description: Frees all JSON data nodes in the list, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: int get_json_plugin_version(json_object * json_obj)
methods.description: Determines plugin version based on JSON object type and content.

methods.name: void json_plugin_find_prefix_obj(const char * full_obj,char * prefix_obj,size_t len)
methods.description: Finds the prefix part of a JSON object path based on its string representation.

methods.name: void json_plugin_find_current_obj(const char * full_obj,char * curr_obj,size_t len)
methods.description: Retrieves the current object name from a full object path.

methods.name: void generate_path_without_instance(char * full_obj,bool is_obj,char * obj_path,size_t len)
methods.description: Generates a JSON object path string without instance-specific parts.

methods.name: json_object * get_requested_json_obj(json_object * json_obj,char * instance,const char * key,char * arr_name,size_t arr_len)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON object within a JSON structure based on path and instance context.

methods.name: int get_number_of_instances(char * refparam)
methods.description: Calculates number of instances from a reference parameter string.

methods.name: int get_bbfdm_type(struct json_object * protocols)
methods.description: Determines the protocol type (UCM, USP, BOTH, NONE) from a JSON array of protocols.

methods.name: void replace_indexes(struct dmctx * ctx,char * old_key,char * new_key,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Replaces index placeholders in object keys with actual instance numbers.

methods.name: void resolve_all_symbols(struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,const char * value,int nbr_instances,int json_version,const char * old_key,char * new_key,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Resolves special symbols and placeholders within strings for JSON object paths.

methods.name: int fill_ubus_arguments(struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,const char * value,int nbr_instances,int json_version,struct json_object * args_obj,struct ubus_arg u_args[])

methods.name: void free_ubus_arguments(struct ubus_arg u_args[],int u_args_size)

methods.name: int browse_obj(struct dmctx * dmctx,DMNODE * parent_node,void * prev_data,char * prev_instance)
